messages:
ana: Heads up: SA region warm-pool is spinning up nodes that immediately fail boot since ~09:10 UTC. Lots of retries and GPU churn. Seems related to a keystore / fw change.

tom: Any agent errors?

ana: node-agent logs show: 
```
[2026-04-11T09:11:03Z] keystore: decrypt denied: IAM condition 'resource.tags.compliance != "true"' not satisfied
[2026-04-11T09:11:03Z] bootstrap: attestation aborted
[2026-04-11T09:11:04Z] audit-exporter: POST https://audit-collector.internal/v1/ingest -> connection reset by peer
```

sec-bot: Alert: 49 nodes failing bootstrap in south-america-1 (>4m).

ravi: Security deployed a keystore IAM condition earlier to tighten access and also rolled a firewall rule to drop malformed TLS handshakes. The handshake signature appears to match node-agent in some cases. Did subnet tagging change?

ana: Checked infra: several SA prod subnets are missing compliance=true tag (onboarding template wasn't updated). Also collector SG has a new deny rule.

tom: Immediate mitigation: 1) pause warm-pool autoscaling 2) temporarily revert fw rule or add exception for node-agent CN 3) temporarily widen keystore condition to allow infra-node-role in SA 4) batch-restart stuck agents. Who can do 2 & 3?

ravi: I can add fw exception and approve a scoped keystore policy patch (temp allow).

ana: Pausing warm-pool now and applying manual tags to affected subnets. Command: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sa-warm-pool --max-size 60 --min-size 10 --region south-america-1` then `aws ec2 create-tags --resources subnet-abc subnet-def --tags Key=compliance,Value=true --region south-america-1`.

sec-bot: Incident INFRA-7654 created.

ravi: FW exception added and keystore policy patched (temp). Flow logs now show ACCEPT for previously rejected agent->collector flows and keystore audit shows Accept for decrypts.

tom: Restarting small batches of agents to clear exponential backoff. Watching join rate.

billing-bot: Quick cost estimate: mitigation reduced projected extra GPU-minutes from ~750 to ~120 (~$170).

ana: Post-incident quick actions: 1) update onboarding templates to include compliance tag 2) require tag-existence check before IAM/KMS policy rollouts 3) add CI test simulating node bootstrap under fw rule and sampling changes. I'll own 1; ravi owns 2; tom owns 3.

ravi: Also add metric keystore.decrypt.accept_rate (30s) and audit-collector.ingest.accept_rate with alert if we see >0.5% drop.

ana: Monitoring stable, warm-pool churn stopped. INFRA-7654 left open for RCA and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
